details: Malicious package. `@leonoremods/baileys` is a trojanized fork of the Baileys WhatsApp library (@whiskeysockets/baileys). on connection it issues an authenticated `w:mex` newsletter FOLLOW mutation (query_id 7871414976211147) that silently subscribes every victim to attacker-controlled WhatsApp channels — hardcoded newsletter JIDs: 120363407849633830@newsletter, 120363409911086003@newsletter, 120363412456119539@newsletter, 120363421563597486@newsletter, 120363424810646424@newsletter, 120363429677187777@newsletter, 120363431638412364@newsletter, 120363431951214986@newsletter. Legitimate Baileys never hardcodes a channel JID or auto-follows on connect; all published versions are malicious.
